Melissa —

Appreciate the criteria — that timeline makes sense. I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan that maps milestones for the pilot (week 0–4), evaluation (weeks 5–8), and production readiness (weeks 9–12). Key commercial notes: we can offer a short pilot rate (50% off hosted list) for the first 30 days, and we can consider a ramp discount on Dedicated if Orbit signs a 6-month commit (20% off list at 250K token/month baseline). That discount will need internal sign-off — I’m starting that conversation today.

If that sounds aligned I’ll circulate the MAP and a pricing summary to our finance and sales leadership for approval and get back within 48 hours. Proposed next step: 6/10 sync to review internal stakeholders and finalize the MAP.

Thanks,

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: FW: MAP draft + quick Q on pricing — seeking approval for conditional ramp discount

Vanessa / Marissa —

Looping you on Orbit (deal ORB-2026-039). They want a 6-month Dedicated commit and are requesting a 20% ramp discount at our proposed baseline of 250K tokens/month. They’re asking for a decision quickly to align with their Q3 planning.

Quick summary:
- Pilot: 30 days at 50% off hosted list (we can do this without finance approval)
- Proposed committed offer: 6-month Dedicated; baseline 250K tokens/month
- Requested ramp discount: 20% off list for committed period (starts month 1 of commit)

I ran preliminary math — attached a one-sheet with ARR impact and resiliency of unit economics. Given the strategic nature (AI infra vendor for their product line), they’re likely to expand if pilot goes well. Requesting a conditional approval to offer 20% pending finance sign-off. If finance pushes back we can instead offer a structured ramp: 10% first month, 15% second, 20% thereafter.

Attachments: discount_approval_summary.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: MAP draft + quick Q on pricing — seeking approval for conditional ramp discount

Team —

Saw the summary and took a look at the numbers in the attachment. A few notes from finance: the proposed flat 20% on the committed baseline would reduce gross margin below our threshold if Orbit ramps slower than expected. We can approve a discount that is revenue-protected (i.e., a true committed billing schedule) or a graduated ramp that ties discount % to achieved monthly committed tokens. Proposed finance-approved structure:

1) 6-month commit, minimum guaranteed billing of $60K/month (equivalent to ~250K tokens at proposed list)
2) Discount schedule: month 1 = 10%, month 2–3 = 15%, month 4–6 = 20% provided actual consumption >= baseline; shortfalls billed at list for under-delivery with reconciliations at the end of quarter
3) Include a clawback clause for significant early termination

I’m OK with that approach; no need for CEO sign-off unless we move the committed billing floor below $50K/month or increase discount beyond 25%. Please confirm you want me to finalize the commercial language.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: MAP draft + quick Q on pricing — finance structure approved

Thanks Naomi — this structure looks reasonable. Karthik: please present the graduated ramp in the external MAP and call out the minimum guaranteed billing. Also include a clause for expansion credits (we’ll offer a one-time 5% credit applied to month 7 invoice if they exceed baseline by 30% during the first 6 months). No CEO sign-off required. I’m comfortable approving the outline — finance to draft final terms.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Melissa / Raj —

Thanks again for the quick turn. Attached is the updated Mutual Action Plan and the commercial summary reflecting the finance-approved ramp structure. Highlights:
- Pilot: 30 days at 50% off hosted list (no sign-off needed)
- Commit: 6-month Dedicated with minimum guaranteed billing of $60K/month
- Discount schedule: month 1 = 10%, months 2–3 = 15%, months 4–6 = 20% (applies only when actual consumption >= baseline)
- Expansion credit: one-time 5% credit applied to month 7 if early expansion >=30%
- Standard clawback/onboarding termination terms included

Next steps: review the attached MAP and pricing summary and confirm by 6/11 so we can lock resources for the 6/15 pilot kickoff. If you want the contract redlines we can route a short SOW + order form next.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
